verdict.rationale: Versioning and rolling back verification workflows is a fair question for an identity-verification platform, so the axis applies. The pack shows no versioning, change review, or rollback for Stripe Identity configurations or automations. Verification Flows only save and reuse a configuration, and the review tools cover manual review of individual verifications, not automation changes. Both are adjacent features and earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can version, review, and roll back my automations
